diagnosis.cause: A started empty encounter created an empty combat observer filter, so the valid native Hide roll was saved without observer results.

policy.combatScope: Use combat observers only when the acting token belongs to the viewed scene encounter roster.
policy.fallback: Empty, stale, unrelated and absent encounters use eligible opposing creatures in the viewed scene.
policy.storedContext: Fallback scene results use a null combatId so a stale encounter cannot invalidate them.

regressions: empty active combat preserves scene observers
unrelated active combat preserves scene observers
native Hide records observer-relative Hidden and mirrored perception
